1976_Ford_Dole/ending/s0.l37.c49/text: Jimmy Carter has been president for 8 years. Inflation has subsided to a steady amount, with unemployment dropping to virtually 0%. The budget had been balanced in 78, and poverty and hunger have been eradicated, as everyone unemployed became a farmer, and is eating peanut butter and peach jam sandwiches. the USSR on the 21st of January had seceded all their land to the USA and declared their government dissolved. Most importantly of all, the government is now trusted more than ever under the leadership of Jimmy Carter, who beat up Richard Nixon on live TV in 1981, garnering a 99% approval rating. Mondale has already won the most recent election 873 electoral votes to 0 against those sorry Republicans, who disbanded shortly after. All is good in the world, thanks to our wonderful leader, Jimmy Carter.
1976_Ford_Dole/ending/s0.l57.c13/text: A number of campaign reforms, many to do with finance will likely be enacted in light of Watergate, as the scandal preceding the Checkers speech Nixon gave in 52 is fresh in the minds of many. If you stay true and honest to America and help fix those problems, poor Reagan won't know what's waiting for him in 80.
